h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Khandwa

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Khandwa

c: Khandwa is about 450 km from our factory in Vasai, one of the shorter trips we make into Madhya Pradesh. FunPlay Systems supplies Fun Fitness outdoor gym equipment to schools, colleges, railway colonies, housing societies and municipal parks in Khandwa. Many visitors also pass through on the way to Omkareshwar, and the hotels and dharamshalas that serve them are another kind of buyer.

Nimar summers are hot and dry, and the monsoon is moderate. That means the gym will face more sun than rain, so shade and placement matter most. Our galvanised frames and roto-moulded seats are made for outdoor use. The road trip from Vasai is short, and our installers or a central India dealer fix each machine grouted or self-standing. Send us the size of your site and photos, and we will return a layout drawing with the clear space for each machine.

richText.heading: A simple gym for a school, colony or dharamshala

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: Which machines suit a dharamshala or hotel near Omkareshwar?
items.a: Gentle machines such as the Fun Cycle, walkers and twisters suit visitors of all ages. They need no setup and take only a few minutes to use.

items.q: How far is Khandwa from your factory?
items.a: About 450 km by road from Vasai. We dispatch from there and install with our own team or a dealer in central India.

items.q: How do we keep seats cool in summer?
items.a: Place seated machines in shade, face them away from the afternoon sun and plan use for mornings and evenings. A pergola over the gym also helps.
